question: Does any non-conventional pairing channel outside the el-ph formula break Tc<=0.364*omega_log (lambda<=4) at AMBIENT pressure + room Tc, and is it first-principles-computable?
verdict: CLOSED-negative; el-ph bound stands as operative ambient ceiling
breakthrough_lever_named: bipolaronic_bond-Peierls_SSH_light_bipolaron (arXiv:2203.07380) - best beyond-el-ph angle, ambient, exact solver, open DFT downfolding loop; honest caveat: ~20-40K not room-Tc

channels.name: Bipolaronic / beyond-Migdal strong coupling (bond-Peierls SSH light bipolaron)
channels.predicted_Tc: ~20-40 K absolute (Tc/Omega~0.2 peak; 'several x' ME bound in Tc/Omega units); room-Tc NOT claimed
channels.ambient_viable: YES (t/Omega~1-2, not hydride; FeSe-class candidate suggestive, unconfirmed)
channels.first_principles_tractable: PARTIAL (bipolaron QMC exact+cheap; DFT->Peierls(dt/du)+U downfolding open, not done end-to-end)
channels.escapes_el_ph_bound: YES (Migdal-lambda framework breaks; knob=bipolaron mass m*, not lambda)

channels.name: Non-adiabatic / vertex corrections (Migdal-Eliashberg breakdown, PGS)
channels.predicted_Tc: No room-Tc; sign-conditional +-tens-%; real materials -30 to -40% (SUPPRESSION)
channels.ambient_viable: YES regime (fullerides, Li-hBN, STO) but corrections there are Tc-suppressing
channels.first_principles_tractable: YES first-order LOVC ab-initio (EPW-VASP, H3S npj)
channels.escapes_el_ph_bound: NO net gain; usually below naive ME

channels.name: Flat-band geometric superfluid weight (Peotta-Toermae D_s ~ integral g)
channels.first_principles_tractable: YES (quantum metric g(k) ground-state Wannier/DFT-computable, cheap, no DFPT |g|^2 wall; U/Delta needs cRPA+MF)
channels.escapes_el_ph_bound: DIFFERENT channel (sets stiffness/Tc not lambda) but RESCUE not enhancement; caps at meV scale
channels.note: Distinct from fleet's lambda-suppression result; geometric D_s rescues finite Tc from zero in flat band but absolute Tc still capped at U*<g>
